item.title: Overgrown brambles on CBC land, 18th August
item.description:
At the back of 29 Sissinghurst Grove where the stream is, the brambles and weeds are pushing the fence over. I believe that the previous owner of the property requested that this area was not to be cut. The rest of the area gets cut back annually. Please could this area be cut back and included in any maintenance schedule. Also the garden shed is now leaning towards the stream as the bottom of the garden is starting to move. No rush as I know everybody is very busy. Thank you
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 20, Sissinghurst Grove, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
